description:
Research Summary

This ARIES project at Earlham Institute investigates how long grassland fungal communities take to recover after disturbance.

It combines soil ecology with sequencing and collaboration with Rothamsted Research.

Official Project Title

How long do grassland fungi take to recover after disturbance

Research Focus and Methods

Sample sites in Norfolk, Hertfordshire and Devon along disturbance-history gradients. Combine fungal metabarcoding with soil chemistry and bacterial comparisons, then examine roots, rhizosphere and bulk soil for a shared grass species.

Research Training and Development

Develop linked field, laboratory and bioinformatics skills.

About Earlham Institute

Earlham Institute is a life sciences research institute based at Norwich Research Park in England. Its research focuses on genomics and computational biology, using experimental and analytical approaches to understand living systems. The institute supports scientific collaboration, specialist technology and researcher training, connecting biological data with questions across diverse organisms.

Official website: https://www.earlham.ac.uk/
